caption: The drawing depicts a single vessel-like object centered on a plain, light tan background. The object is rounded in shape with a bulbous body, a short cylindrical neck at the top, and a longer cylindrical base at the bottom. The surface of the object is adorned with a crosshatched diamond pattern encircling the widest part of the vessel, while the area near the neck shows vertical linear ridges. At the bottom, just above the cylindrical base, there is a band with a scalloped or beaded design. The drawing is rendered in grayscale, giving the object a metallic or ceramic appearance, with careful shading to suggest depth and texture. There are no additional elements besides the vessel and the background, and the background is slightly mottled with age, showing small stains and discolorations. The name “JOHN DANA” is faintly inscribed in the lower left corner.
title: Peg Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
